I have farmed these soils for many rains, and beans have always grown well here without needing those expensive chemicals from the shop. I will plant the bean seeds I saved from last season and spread what manure my goats and chickens have given us, because that is what my father taught me and what I can afford. We will wait for the rains and work the plot as a family—my children and grandchildren will help me with the planting, weeding, and harvest, as we do not have money to pay outside workers.
